title: Text: DET Greg Garno ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Do you know when they’re releasing the schedule
Monday I think because they want to announce 2021 schedule at the same time.
MLB wants to. Idk, no one in marketing has really seen it
Seems dumb. Could just do the 2020 schedule and the 2021 schedule when you usually do in September and get TWO reveals
Not even that, you shouldn’t release 2021 at the same time as 2020 because you’ll just confuse fans.
But I’m in the market for an Yzerman tweet
Just sniffing around. Maybe something like, “If anyone can win the Draft lottery, Stevie can.”
“Certainly Detroits messiah can work a miracle tonight. Right?”
